title: evict_if_needed has no bounds check for max_peers = 0
description:
**File:** rust/lichen-link/src/link_layer.rs
**Lines:** 358-371 (ReplayProtector), 526-542 (LinkLayer)

**Issue:** Both evict_if_needed implementations use 'while self.peers.len() > self.max_peers'. If max_peers is set to 0, all peers are evicted immediately after any insert.

**Trigger:** Constructing LinkLayer or ReplayProtector with max_peers = 0 (currently hardcoded to 64, but the field is not validated).

**Bad behavior:** All peers evicted, link layer becomes non-functional.

**Suggested fix:** Either: (1) make max_peers a NonZeroUsize, (2) add debug_assert!(max_peers > 0) in constructor, or (3) document that max_peers = 0 means unlimited. If future API exposes max_peers configuration, this becomes exploitable.
